cta.title: Get Your Call Schedule Done Right
cta.description: Join 30+ departments across 20+ hospitals and practices who already outsource scheduling to experts.

faq.answer: Call schedule software typically refers to self-service tools that help programs manually build on-call schedules. Scheduling Wizard takes a different approach: it is a managed service, not a self-service platform. Programs submit their rules and receive finished, ACGME-compliant call schedules as Excel files; there is no software to learn or operate. This eliminates the burden on chief residents and program coordinators who would otherwise spend hundreds of hours each year building schedules manually.
faq.question: What is call schedule software and how does Scheduling Wizard differ?

faq.answer: ACGME duty hour compliance is built into the schedule as it is built. Our team applies the 80-hour weekly limit, minimum rest requirements between shifts, call frequency caps, and subspecialty-specific rules as rules that cannot be broken. This means the rules are applied while the schedule is built, not discovered manually after the schedule has already been published to residents.
faq.question: How does Scheduling Wizard ensure ACGME compliance in call schedules?

faq.answer: Yes. Scheduling Wizard uses a proprietary the way we write down your rules system that accepts program-specific rules including site requirements, resident preferences, moonlighting restrictions, parental leave, conference attendance, and multi-site arrangements. No rule is too unusual, the managed service model means an expert scheduler works through your program's requirements directly.
faq.question: Can Scheduling Wizard handle our program's specific call scheduling rules and requests?

faq.answer: Finished call schedules are delivered as Excel or Google Sheets files, ready to use immediately. If you want one, we can also build a custom live viewing link designed around your schedules. Programs can upload these files directly to their existing schedule publishing platform, for day-to-day resident access. Scheduling Wizard handles the schedule creation and optimization; you publish and distribute it where you already do.
faq.question: What format are the finished call schedules delivered in?

faq.answer: Call burden is distributed algorithmically across all residents, balancing overnight call, weekend shifts, and holiday assignments equitably. Our team treats fairness as a core objective, not an afterthought. This eliminates the manual guesswork and fairness disputes that frequently arise with spreadsheet-based scheduling, where call burden imbalances often go unnoticed until residents compare schedules.
faq.question: How does Scheduling Wizard handle fairness in call schedule distribution?

faq.answer: Scheduling Wizard supports rapid re-optimization when unplanned absences occur, such as illness or emergency leave. Rather than manually reshuffling the entire schedule, our team generates updated coverage options for the affected shifts while maintaining compliance and fairness across the rest of the call schedule.
faq.question: What happens when a resident unexpectedly cannot cover a call shift?
